revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_014
Primary request: Create one premium collectible steps achievement medal for tier 14, GOLD rank, SECOND and highest medal in the gold pair. Based on the Chinese title concept "地球说‘我是谁呀，我是您脚底的一颗痣而已’" (the earth is tiny under your foot). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot style: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 14 pose: the foot mascot stands grandly with one tiny bare foot on a small stylized globe/planet like it is just a tiny speck underfoot, looking ridiculously majestic and proud, with orbit sparkles and footprint path dots. Keep the foot as the main character; no text or symbols.
Medal border: GOLD rank, SECOND and highest gold medal. Use an extravagant polished gold circular border with bright gold gems, elegant crown crest, ornate bottom flourish, and clearly visible symmetrical gold side wings / feather-like golden wings extending outward from the circle. Strong but controlled golden sparkle light effects. This must be more ornate than tier 13 and read as the final highest achievement medal.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals and previous anthropomorphic foot candidates: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central foot mascot fully inside circular core, side wings visible but inside safe margins.
Lighting/mood: bright golden studio highlights, triumphant, majestic, funny.
Color palette: polished gold and bright champagne border, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, tiny blue-green globe accents, golden sparkles; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: include gold side wings, include feather-like golden wings, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold; second medal of each color pair has wings
wing_rule: second medal in color pair has wings
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
